svg.aria-label: GRACE: an unlearning request yields a forget direction; GRACE selects a compact forget coreset by non-negative orthogonal matching pursuit and a retain coreset by projecting out the forget direction and clustering; both are passed to an unlearning method, which removes the target knowledge while preserving model utility.
svg.text: gradient-guided coreset selection for LLM unlearning

g.text: per-sample gradients of a mixed training corpus
gf -aligned scoring → NN-OMP → compact forget coreset
project gf out → cluster → representative retain coreset
